decisions.reason: This custom earmold remains very close to our established hearing-technology know-how, customers, and in-house R&D, so our absorptive capacity to improve and support it stays high.
The custom in-ear earmold sits squarely in our core competence base and customer workflows, so continued learning from market use makes retention more attractive than withdrawal.

Although it uses some transferable digital-manufacturing skills, the orthopedic shoe last is too far from our main dental and hearing knowledge base and channels for us to build and commercialise it efficiently.
The post-curing unit fits our digital, automated production direction and related process expertise, giving us good scope to refine it further even though it is still an early-stage launch.
